title: School Leadership & Institutional Operations
description: Administrative cockpit for school principals and leadership to govern academic cycles, review daily attendance health, manage teacher assignments, and coordinate school-wide announcements.

intents.title: Monitor Daily School Operations Pulse
intents.outcome: Inspect student attendance completion, teacher vitality, and school grade status.

journeys.title: Audit School Attendance & Operational Health
journeys.situation: A school principal enters their institutional dashboard to verify that morning attendance has been taken across all classrooms and that faculty staffing is secure.
journeys.outcome: Real-time school attendance summary and teacher status are verified.
preconditions: Authenticated account possesses an active principal bond to the school.

existingBehavior: PrincipalDashboard provides institutional grade completion and student counts.
Staff leave and attendance session aggregates exist in database models.
invariants: Principal authority is strictly scoped to the bound school_id.
Unpublished grades and private student records remain protected under student privacy policies.
openQuestions: How are emergency school-wide notices dispatched to offline student and guardian devices?

steps.title: Review Daily Attendance
steps.interaction: Inspect classroom attendance snapshot and grade mark publishing status.

requirements.title: Strict School Tenancy Isolation
requirements.statement: Principals must only observe records belonging to their authorized school jurisdiction.

bindings.title: Principal Web Dashboard
bindings.note: Renders school pulse, teacher rosters, and grading completion.

scenarios.title: Audit Daily Classroom Attendance
scenarios.expected: Daily attendance completion rate is rendered for all active classrooms.

intents.title: Configure Academic Cycles & Term Periods
intents.outcome: Define term start/end dates, subjects, and timetable period templates.

journeys.title: Establish Academic Term & Schedule
journeys.situation: At the start of an academic term, the principal configures the cycle calendar and approves timetable periods.
journeys.outcome: Academic cycle is published and timetable periods become available to teachers and students.
preconditions: Authenticated account has active administrative authority over the school.

existingBehavior: principalTermSetupFlow defines the JTBD sequence for term creation.
AcademicCycle, Term, and TimetablePeriod models exist in schema.zmodel.
invariants: Existing academic cycles cannot be deleted while active grade marks or attendance records refer to them.
openQuestions: Should multi-track or semester schedules be supported concurrently within a single school?

steps.title: Initiate Term Configuration
steps.interaction: Navigate to school settings and select Academic Setup.

steps.title: Publish Academic Cycle
steps.interaction: Input dates, confirm period schedule, and submit.

transitions.title: Save and Activate Term
transitions.feedback: Term is activated and published across school rosters.

requirements.title: Atomic Cycle Activation
requirements.statement: Activating a new academic term must transition historical terms to archived without orphan grades.

bindings.title: Principal Term Setup Flow DAG
bindings.note: Flow DAG orchestrating term setup and timetable creation.

scenarios.title: Activate New Academic Term
scenarios.expected: New term is marked active and timetable periods become available.
